request: Download a large image set, label and organize it before running the unchanged system, report failures.

collectionPlan.garmentsAndGear: Aim for 100 licensed garment/gear images, prefer item-only photographs and defect/hard-negative views; retain selection exclusions.
collectionPlan.fabricCloseups: 80 original distinct photographs stratified by publisher class, separate out-of-domain morphology stress section.
collectionPlan.leatherCloseups: 20 distinct raw leather photos, label only visible condition, separate stress section.

labelRules.history: Unknown for every photograph; do not label crash involvement from appearance.
labelRules.source: Label from direct visual review and publisher annotation where present. Not expert physical inspection.
labelRules.leakage: No candidate training, threshold tuning, or app/model changes during this audit. Freeze labels before any system run. Keep old examples in a separate regression set.
labelRules.groups: Group related garment views and capture sessions; do not count quality variants as independent images.

metrics: Missed defects among visually labelled positive photos
False flags among visually labelled negative photos
Wrong defect type and invented anatomy on inspected failures
Malformed results, runtime errors and timeouts
